slides.headline: You're running an ad you never *approved*.
slides.subhead: Google flipped it on September 1. When did you last check your own settings? ->

slides.headline: Google began auto migrating Search campaigns onto *AI Max* — without asking.
The only notice was an email sent in early August. Google published *no blog post* explaining it.
AI Max matches search terms beyond your keyword list, rewrites your ad copy, and sends clicks to the page it *picks*.

slides.sub: Google's average lift in conversions — and it only helps the advertiser who is actually watching what changed.

slides.headline: The account you built did not change overnight. The rules running *underneath* it did — and nothing forces you to notice.
The founders who caught this in week one had one habit: read the *settings*, not just the results.
Save this. *Send it* to a marketer who hasn't opened Ads Manager.
